_source: Approved rows from src/data/reviews.json, copied verbatim (every field unchanged). match: programme = left on this course's own feedback form; text-mention = left on another LevelUp form but the text names this course; related = another LevelUp programme in the same craft. Picked 17 Oct 2026 so no review appears on two masterclass pages.

reviews.name: Bavatharani A.
reviews.text: To be honest, I have enjoyed each chapters of this class. Being a fresher I came to know about lots of technical details in making a film. However Karthik Subbaraj has shared his own style of filmmaking, the course helped me to find out my own way of script writing and creating it into a screen play. Apart from all the insightful lectures, the resources that the Levelup has provided was really helpful in coordinating and processing the storyline into a strong narration and script ❤️

reviews.name: Sanjay D.
reviews.text: Simple brilliant! I liked the way various episodes have been separated according to their content like introduction, responsibility of a film maker, writing etc. although people like me who do not understand Tamil have to depend on subtitles, that becomes cumbersome but hats off to his knowledge. Brilliant learning experience for me 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼

reviews.name: Yasir P.
reviews.text: Levelup- Learning will help lot's of peoples who wants to become filmmaker..Once again thank you so much Karthik Subbaraj sir for u advice and valuable words....

reviews.name: Sree P.
reviews.text: I have attended three to four workshops and Thursday free classes and also took photography and Karthik Subburaj classes.. all are perfect. Stuffs are like studying in film school. Happy to be part of levelup!

reviews.name: Surya P.
reviews.text:
Love the organised way to guide with materials and webinars for the ones who love Cinema and filmmaking and screen writing.
Karthik Subburaj masterclass was nicely planned and organised!

reviews.text:
This class gives me that , courage to shoot my script confidently, I'm from Andhra Pradesh village area so we know how to love cinema but we don't know how to create a cinema.
I have lot of consepts I'll work on it by the help of this class

reviews.name: Anirudh R.
reviews.text: Hi guys ! I am anirudh I had huge doubt about my script and my camera shots but when I got into level up . This course is cool enough to teach us and motivate us towards making our films ! Hope you guys join soon and become a director soon!

reviews.name: Abhishek
reviews.text: I want to make films, but I am just a designer but this only 2hour workshop gave me the knowledge & the confidence to take the first step, so much things that people have to learn over the years in the industry, the mentor gave the same insights in only 2 hours, Thank You for making this.

reviews.name: Ashwini P.
reviews.text: It was my first hand experience into film making and direction. Getting insight in the film making will be helpful in planning my own short videos that I do for my business and try my hands into making of catchy and creative videos.

reviews.name: Nitin N.
reviews.role: Designer and an Aspiring Film maker
reviews.text: I am an aspiring filmmaker, a storyteller rather. I have multiple stories to tell. I have written a few scripts. But what's stopping me is how to get that produced, like what's next? This workshop helped me get quite a good clarity on that. I got quite a lot of information to put in and to work on.
